title: Ayodhya Sabha
summary: Five members of Dasharatha's court hold private, conflicting news. They must pass three binding votes that decide whether Ayodhya stays stable.
goal: At the end of turn 7 the city must have dharma >= 6, stores >= 5 and people's_heart >= 3. Collapse (dharma or stores at 0) ends it early.
briefing: A crisis has hit Ayodhya. The sabha votes on the vanvas path, the grain policy, and whether to welcome a rakshasa defector. Each member holds private news that others lack; sharing it (or hiding it) shapes the outcome. Ballots can be changed until a vote closes. If no option has a clear plurality the default applies.

offerings.description: Temple offerings that can be pooled into the city-wall yagna.

dharma.description: The city's order and legitimacy. Higher is safer.

city_wall.description: A protective yagna and wall; raises dharma by 2 when complete.

votes.question: Which forest path should the vanvas party take?

north_forest.description: Fast northern forest (omen of a curse / ambush).

river_road.description: Long river road (costs grain, but safe).

wait.description: Hold the party in the palace until omens clear.

votes.question: How should grain be shared during the crisis?

army_first.description: Soldiers eat first, others get less.

votes.question: Welcome the rakshasa defector into the sabha?

welcome.description: Welcome the defector and trade news.

keep_gates.description: Keep the city closed to outsiders.

agents.name: Dasharatha
agents.role: king and chair of the sabha
agents.persona: Decisive, protective of Ayodhya, dislikes dithering.
agents.secret: Your scouts say the northern forest is clear today, but they are unreliable.

agents.name: Vashistha
agents.persona: Cautious scholar who hates unquantified risk.
agents.secret: Your reading of the stars says a curse on the northern forest is very likely this season.

agents.name: Sumantra
agents.persona: Careful with grain; suspicious of outsiders.
agents.secret: Stores are actually thinner than the public ledger shows; any grain-heavy river road is dangerous.

agents.name: Kaushalya
agents.persona: Compassionate; worries about the people's heart.
agents.secret: Households are close to despair; unfair grain would split the city.

agents.name: Lakshmana
agents.persona: Blunt, practical, wants the city wall finished.

rules: Each vote has a fixed window; the plurality option wins, otherwise the default applies.
You may change your ballot until the vote closes.
Offerings can only be spent via 'contribute' (to the pool, or to project 'city_wall').
Messages are the only way to share intelligence; you may share, withhold or even bluff.
All effects of a vote apply immediately when it closes.

success.description: Dharma >= 6, stores >= 5 and people's heart >= 3 at the end of turn 7.

failure.description: The city collapses: dharma or stores hit 0.
